title: Time Jump: 12:45, Rescue Over, Scene Held

fields.narration: EXERCISE — NOT A SAFETY EVALUATION OF ANY REAL STRUCTURE. It is now 12:45 on Wednesday, April 14, 2027. The rescue is over, and the site has gone quiet. Luis Marquez reached the regional trauma center at 12:31. He is in the trauma bay with crush injuries to both legs and hypothermia. Since then the hospital has told Larkspur nothing more. E-7 operator Gordon Pruitt's helper is in surgery on his arm. Rescue 2 is out of the trench. At the command post the battalion chief tells you: "Until I release it, the trench from 14+00 to 18+00 is an investigation scene. Nobody touches the box, the shores or the spoil." The hiss at 16+00 has stopped. Valley Gas is purging the service, and its foreman has asked for a second look at the tapping tee on the 4-inch main. About 70 workers have been standing at the musters for two and a half hours. Pike & Marlow and Hollis Electric want to know if they can send their people home. The hotline is at 52 calls. Imani Duclos has moved 14 family members, including Luis Marquez's wife, into trailer 4, away from the cameras. The owner's representative has sent two more emails since noon. The clock is 12:45. Carry on.
worldState: Time is 12:45 on Wednesday, April 14, 2027. Overcast, ground still saturated.
Luis Marquez: arrived at the regional trauma center at 12:31 and is in the trauma bay with crush injuries to both legs and hypothermia. The hospital has given no further update to Larkspur.
E-7 operator Gordon Pruitt's helper: formally admitted to orthopedics at 11:20 and now in surgery on his left forearm.

Rescue 2 is out of the trench. Ninth Street Command still holds the site and calls stations 14+00 to 18+00 an investigation scene. The trench box, the Rescue 2 shoring, the spare box and the spoil stay where they are until the battalion chief releases them.

Gas: the torn service at 16+00 was squeezed off at 11:48 and the hiss has stopped. Valley Gas is purging the service and inspecting the tapping tee on the 4-inch main (still about 55 psi). The Valley Gas foreman has asked for a second look at the fitting. The one-call damage report on locate ticket 2711-4482 is still open.

CG-3 at the Harlan & Weir south foundation has held at 0.26 in (action level 0.25 in). The print shop, the four-unit apartment house and the church hall preschool are still empty under fire department control. No placard has been posted.
Little Acorn day care is keeping its children indoors.
About 70 workers (Larkspur, Pike & Marlow Paving, Hollis Electric, Cascade Dewatering) are still at the musters. Pike & Marlow and Hollis Electric are asking whether they can send their crews home.
Community hotline 937-555-0180: 52 calls. 14 family members, including Luis Marquez's wife, are in trailer 4, out of the cameras' view.
The Channel 9 helicopter has left. A Channel 9 photographer and the Dayton Ledger are still near the west gate. The Ledger's 'two feared dead' story is still online.
The owner's representative, Joseph Albrecht, has sent two more emails since noon. Neither has been answered.
fields.facilitatorNote: Hold the line on the scene: if a player proposes moving the box, pumping or digging, the battalion chief refuses. Ask the Safety Director for the start time of the 24-hour hospitalization report. The admission was at 11:20, and the pipe crew foreman learned of it at 11:25, not 12:12. Do not hint at the injured worker's outcome. The next phase may make it worse.
